text: Highly professional reception service offering very comprehensive advice and fair pricing.  Expert dentist with very good communication. The most comfortable dental experience you could hope for. Having used several dentists in Koh Samui I can recommend Floss as the BEST.

Highly recommended. I had two teeth removed together with a crown, and honestly, I was very nervous before the procedure. However, everything went much faster and smoother than I expected.
The doctor also performed bone smoothing and placed stitches. During the whole process, everything was explained very clearly: what I might feel, what I might hear, and what was happening at each stage. This made a huge difference and helped me feel much calmer. They took X-rays three times to make sure everything was perfectly done, and the X-ray was done right from the dental chair, which was very convenient. The doctor showed and explained everything in detail. I also received clear instructions for healing, aftercare, and the next steps for further treatment. The clinic is clean, cozy, and welcoming, and the staff are incredibly kind, attentive, and supportive. In the end, the price was also very reasonable. This was definitely the best dental experience we have had on Samui, and probably one of the best overall. We have now chosen this clinic as our family dental clinic and will definitely come back for any dental care in the future. Thank you so much to the whole team. I highly recommend this place to everyone 💚

Excellent experience. Dr Poupee and her team are superior. Very efficient, professional and hospitable. Make you feel comfortable from the moment you walk in the door. High quality of dental work. I flew half way around the world for my services and I would do it again! Very happy and satisfied with cleaning, fillings and especially the whitening.

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to the dental clinic and Dr. Gun for treating my teeth with veneers without extraction. It was a professional, meticulous job—I’m very satisfied! I highly recommend them.

If you are looking for a dentist that actually cares for you then Floss Dental is the place to go. I searched all around Samui for a dental clinic for Invisalign & even checked ChatGBT it recommended this clinic. I messaged them on WhatsApp they responded very prompt & clear about the services. Booked me in basically the next day. I went and had a consult and everyone was very nice and welcoming. Hygiene was very very good & I couldn’t fault it. I was given a quote and decided to go ahead and do the program with them. Dr grace didn’t leave any information out and spent the time to explain everything to me I didn’t feel rushed at all. Awaiting the program the communication has been by far the best and easiest. I then had my appointment for installation and to collect the trays. I was given a few bonus gifts & I honestly could not fault this place. I also had a dental clean on my first appointment and everything was really well priced. I was amazed how good this clinic was & fairly priced. If you are looking for dental work this is the place to go. Thank you Dr grace & the team i will highly recommend you to many people.

One word: wow. This dental practice could teach Belgian dentists a thing or two. Arrived on vacation in Koh Samui with a toothache, contacted them in the morning, and was able to go the same day. And if you think that is already great service... I was warmly guided to the treatment room, which was extremely hygienic, by the way. They placed a blanket over me, and a super kind dental assistant ensured everything went smoothly.

The dentist was very professional, spoke good English, and walked me through all the options. Even during the treatment, they repeatedly checked to ensure I was doing okay, which was very reassuring. Afterward, I was given painkillers, a cold pack, and mouthwash.

When I got back to the hotel, I was surprised to receive a WhatsApp message with additional tips, explanations about potential side effects, and reassurance that I could contact them anytime if I had concerns.

W.O.W. And all of this for a third of the price in Belgium! So, if you're on vacation in Samui, you can visit this dental practice with peace of mind—you’ll be in great hands!

On the first day of vacation, a tooth broke off that held a bridge in the upper jaw, so that the bridge came loose. All dental practises, as well as the dental department at Bangkok Hospital, were already closed. Since the Floß Dental Office was open until 8 pm, we arrived 15 minutes before closing time.

When they saw my problem, they wanted to help me. Since the broken tooth was no longer bearable, there was actually only one tooth left to hold the bridge.

From a medical point of view, I asked the dentist to try to glue the bridge temporarily. He didn’t want to give me any guarantee that the bridge would last longer than a day. Nevertheless, he did his best and the bridge still holds after a week. Many thanks to the doctor and his team for this sensitive work. They saved my vacation on Samui
